guidance: CSV templates for CMA-Flow SME uploads designed for descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics.
Prefer 12+ months for monthly forecasting; 24+ months is stronger when seasonality matters.
Normally one transaction/order/booking/job/visit/project/batch per row. Do not mix grains in one CSV.
Use ISO format YYYY-MM-DD whenever possible.
Store numeric values without currency symbols; retain one consistent currency per file or add a currency_code field.
Leave genuinely unavailable values blank; do not encode missing numeric values as 0 unless zero is true.
Use stable IDs for customers, products/services, orders/jobs, staff, properties, vehicles, etc.
Requires a target variable such as revenue, demand/quantity, churn_flag, cancellation_flag, delay, defect, occupancy, or rating.
Uses controllable variables such as price, discount, capacity, inventory, staffing, ad spend, reorder level, delivery/service time, or resource cost.
Common fields are intentionally repeated across industries to support schema profiling, semantic-role detection, mechanism discovery, and cross-category analytics.
